targets.rawSql: SELECT product_id, order_lines, units_sold, revenue, low_stock_lines FROM reporting.product_sales ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id
SELECT product_id, events, revenue FROM reporting.stream_product_sales ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id

panels.title: Pipeline data quality and processing time

targets.rawSql: SELECT finished_at AS time, pipeline, batch_id, rows_seen, rows_rejected, rows_written, rows_skipped, round((100 * error_rate)::numeric, 2) AS error_pct, round(duration_seconds::numeric, 3) AS duration_seconds, alert FROM reporting.pipeline_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(finished_at) ORDER BY finished_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT 100
